texte: We read every review rated three stars or below and reply within 2 business days. A reply always starts by acknowledging the specific problem the customer describes, in plain words, and apologises once. It never blames the customer, the carrier or the manufacturer in public. When a reply promises something, such as a refund, a replacement or a store credit, the promise must follow this policy exactly, including the conditions that apply, for example a photo or an order number. If the case needs information we do not have, the reply explains how the customer can send it privately through the Help page of their account. We never ask for payment card details, passwords or full home addresses in a public reply. Replies are signed by the Customer Care team, without personal names.

Customers can reach Customer Care through the Help page of their account, by chat from 8 am to 8 pm Eastern time, Monday to Saturday, or by email through the contact form. Every claim needs the order number, which appears in the confirmation email and in the Orders section of the account. Claims about damaged, spoiled, wrong or missing products also need at least one photo showing the product and, when visible, its label, best-before date and lot number. Messages sent outside opening hours are answered the next business day. We do not handle claims through public review replies or social media comments, because they would expose order details: a public reply points the customer to the private channel instead.

A claim about an order must be opened within 30 days of the delivery date shown in the order tracking. This applies to damaged, missing, late, wrong, expired or stale products, and to promotion or pricing errors. Food safety concerns are the only exception: a foreign object, a suspected contamination, an illness or an allergic reaction can be reported at any time, even after 30 days and even if the product has been partly eaten. Claims opened after 30 days for other reasons are reviewed case by case by a team lead, who may offer a store credit but is not required to. The 30-day limit is counted in calendar days, not business days.

titre: How and when refunds are paid
texte: Once a claim is approved, the refund is sent to the original payment method within 5 business days. Banks usually take 3 to 5 more business days to show it on the statement, so a refund can take up to 10 business days to appear. Gift card payments are refunded to the gift card balance. A refund can cover a single item, several items or the whole order, depending on the problem; shipping fees are refunded only when the whole order is affected, or when the delivery was lost or more than 3 business days late. We do not refund in cash and we do not send checks. Customers receive an email when the refund is issued, with the amount and the items concerned.

titre: What we never do in a reply
texte: To protect customers and keep our promises reliable, a reply to a review never promises a refund, replacement or credit that this policy does not provide, and never promises a delay shorter than the ones stated here. It never confirms or discusses a medical diagnosis, never states that a product is safe or unsafe before the quality team has investigated, and never admits legal liability. It never shares information about another customer or another order. It never offers a discount code in public. When a customer asks for something outside this policy, the reply says that a member of the team will look at the request personally, and the case is escalated rather than refused or accepted on the spot.

titre: Personal data in reviews and claims
texte: Reviews are public. If a customer writes personal information in a review, such as a phone number, an email address, a home address or details about their health, we do not repeat it in our reply, and we invite the customer to continue the conversation privately through the Help page. We use the information sent in a claim, including photos, only to handle that claim and to improve our products and suppliers; we keep it for 3 years, then delete it. Customers can ask at any time for a copy of the data we hold about them, or for its deletion, through the privacy form of their account. We never sell customer data and we never use review content in advertising without written permission.

titre: When a person takes over the case
texte: Some cases go to a Customer Care team lead instead of following the standard steps, and the reply says that a team member will contact the customer within 1 business day. This happens when the problem is not covered by this policy, when it is the customer's third claim within 6 months, when the customer mentions legal action, a journalist or a regulator, when the customer explicitly asks to speak to a person, or when the order is worth more than $150. The team lead can approve exceptions that the standard policy does not allow. Food safety cases follow their own procedure with the quality and safety team, which is faster and always takes priority over this one.

titre: Damaged or broken item on arrival
texte: If an item arrives broken, crushed, dented so that the seal is open, or leaking, we replace it or refund it, as the customer prefers. This applies even when the outside of the box looks fine and the damage is only visible once the box is opened. We need the order number and a photo of the damaged item and of the box it came in, sent within 30 days of delivery. The customer does not need to send the item back: food that arrived damaged should be thrown away safely, and glass should be wrapped before disposal. A replacement ships free of charge within 2 business days. If other items in the same box were soiled by a leak, they are included in the claim. A dent that does not open the packaging, for example on a can with an intact seal, is not a defect: the product is safe to eat and is not refunded.

Chocolate, candy, gummies, butter-based snacks and some oils can soften or melt in hot weather. From May to September we ship these products in insulated packaging with cold packs, and we pause their shipment when the forecast at the destination exceeds 95 degrees Fahrenheit. If a heat-sensitive product still arrives melted or deformed, the customer can choose a refund or a replacement, with a photo sent within 30 days of delivery; no return is needed. A product that melted and then set again, such as chocolate with a white bloom, is safe to eat, but we still refund or replace it because it is not what the customer paid for. Gummies stuck together count as heat damage.

Large orders may arrive in up to 3 separate parcels, sometimes on different days; the tracking page shows each parcel. If an item is still missing 2 days after the last parcel was delivered, the customer can report it within 30 days of that delivery. We check the packing record of the order and, if the item was not shipped or cannot be traced, we send it again free of charge within 2 business days or refund it, as the customer prefers. When a multipack arrives with fewer units than stated on the listing, for example 10 bars instead of 12, this is handled as a quantity problem with the product listing, not as a missing parcel: see the policy on quantity, size and weight.

Standard delivery takes 2 to 5 business days after shipping, and the order page shows an estimated delivery window. If an order arrives more than 3 business days after the end of that window, we refund the shipping fee automatically, without a claim. If the late order contained refrigerated or fresh products, the customer should not eat them if they arrived warm, and we refund those items in full. Late deliveries do not entitle the customer to a refund of dry, shelf-stable products that arrived intact. We do not control carrier delays caused by storms or holidays, but we still refund the shipping fee in those cases. Express shipping that misses its date is refunded the full express fee.

A parcel is treated as lost when its tracking has not been updated for 7 days, or when it has not been delivered 10 business days after shipping. The customer can open a claim from the order page; we then ask the carrier for an investigation, which takes up to 5 business days. If the parcel is not found, we send the order again free of charge or refund it in full, including shipping fees, as the customer prefers. The customer does not have to wait for the end of the carrier investigation when the order contains perishable products: those are refunded or reshipped immediately. If a lost parcel is finally delivered after a refund, the customer may keep it.

titre: Parcel marked as delivered but not received
texte: Sometimes the tracking shows a parcel as delivered when the customer has not received it. We ask the customer to wait 48 hours, because carriers sometimes scan parcels early, and to check with neighbours, building reception and safe places around the door. After 48 hours, the customer can open a claim; we ask the carrier for the GPS position and the photo of the delivery, which takes up to 5 business days. If the parcel cannot be found, we send the order again or refund it in full. To prevent repeated losses, a customer who reports a third undelivered parcel within 6 months is contacted by a team lead, who may suggest a pickup point.

A box can arrive scuffed, wet or crushed on the outside while the products inside are intact and sealed. In that case the products are safe and we do not refund or replace them, but we take the feedback seriously: every report of poor packaging is sent to our warehouse team, which reviews the packing method for the products concerned. If any product inside has an open, punctured or swollen seal, it must not be eaten, and the claim is handled as a damaged item, with a refund or replacement. Customers who receive many boxes in poor condition can ask for extra protective packaging on their account, free of charge.

Customers sometimes find our boxes too large for what they contain, or regret the amount of plastic. We choose box sizes automatically from a small set of standard formats, which can leave empty space for small orders; the space is filled with recycled paper, never with plastic air pillows since 2025. All our boxes and paper filling are recyclable with household cardboard. Insulated liners used for heat-sensitive and cold products can be returned free of charge with a prepaid label available on the Help page. Packaging feedback does not lead to a refund, but it is counted every month and shared with the warehouse team, and we reply to thank the customer for it.

titre: Refrigerated or frozen products that arrived warm
texte: Refrigerated and frozen products ship in insulated boxes designed to stay cold for 48 hours after delivery time. If a refrigerated product arrives above 40 degrees Fahrenheit, or a frozen product arrives thawed, the customer should not eat it, even if it looks and smells normal, because bacteria can grow without visible signs. We refund the affected products in full, without return, on the basis of a photo of the product and of the box, sent within 30 days of delivery. The customer should throw the products away. If the delivery was late, the shipping fee is also refunded. We do not reship cold products automatically, because the same route could fail again.

titre: Taste guarantee for a first purchase
texte: Taste is personal, and a product that arrived intact and within its date is not defective just because a customer does not like it. To let customers try new products without risk, we offer a taste guarantee: the first time a customer buys a given product and does not like its taste, smell or texture, we give a store credit equal to the price paid for that item, up to $15, once per product and per customer. No photo and no return are needed. The credit is valid 12 months on any order. The taste guarantee does not apply to a product the customer has bought before, and it is not a cash refund. Customers can request it within 30 days of delivery.

titre: Texture or taste different from usual
texte: When a customer who knows a product says that it tastes or feels different from usual, for example harder, softer, grittier, more watery or less flavourful, it can be a sign of a batch problem rather than a matter of taste. We ask for the lot number and the best-before date printed on the package, and a photo. The quality team compares the report with other reports on the same lot. If the lot is confirmed as faulty, we refund or replace the product. If the lot is normal, we offer the taste guarantee credit when it applies. If the taste or smell suggests that the product has gone off, such as a sour, rancid or musty note, the case is handled as a freshness problem.

Manufacturers sometimes change a recipe, an ingredient supplier or a production site, and long-time customers notice it. We do not decide recipes for the brands we sell, but we forward every recipe complaint to the manufacturer each month, with the number of reports. When a recipe change is announced, we update the ingredient list and description of the listing within 7 days. A changed recipe is not a defect and is not refunded if the listing was up to date when the customer ordered. If the listing still showed the old ingredients or claims at the time of the order, the product did not match its description and the customer can get a refund under the policy on misleading listings.

titre: Natural variations that are not defects
texte: Some changes in look or texture are natural and do not mean that a product is spoiled. Honey crystallises over time; placing the jar in warm water makes it liquid again. Natural peanut and almond butters separate, with oil on top, and need stirring. Dark chocolate can show a white bloom when it has been warm, without any effect on safety. Coffee beans vary slightly in taste from one harvest to the next, and loose tea can be stronger or milder between batches. Dried fruit can harden in dry air. In these cases we explain the cause in our reply. If the customer still dislikes the product, the taste guarantee credit may apply for a first purchase.

titre: Coffee and tea that taste weak or bitter
texte: Coffee and tea complaints often come from preparation: water that is too hot makes green tea bitter, and too little coffee for the amount of water makes it weak. Each listing gives the recommended dose, water temperature and brewing time, and our reply can point the customer to them. Pods and capsules are made for the machines listed on the product page; using them in another machine can change the taste. If the customer followed the instructions and the product still tastes stale, flat or burnt, we ask for the best-before date and lot number and handle the case as a possible batch problem. A first purchase that the customer simply does not like falls under the taste guarantee.

titre: Too sweet, too salty or too spicy
texte: Customers sometimes find a product much sweeter, saltier or spicier than they expected. When the listing gives the nutrition facts and a spice level, and the product matches them, this is a matter of taste: the taste guarantee credit applies for a first purchase, and we forward the feedback to the manufacturer. When the listing does not match the product, for example a sauce sold as mild that carries a hot label, or a snack sold as low sugar whose label shows a high sugar content, the product does not match its description and the policy on misleading listings applies, with a refund. We encourage customers to read the nutrition panel shown on every listing before ordering.

Taste and texture reviews are useful even when they do not lead to a refund. Every month we send each brand we sell a summary of the reviews of its products, with the share of complaints by type: taste, texture, smell, freshness, packaging and price. Brands with repeated complaints on the same product are asked for an explanation, and we may stop selling a product whose complaints stay high for 3 months in a row. In our reply, we can thank the customer and say that the feedback has been passed on to the manufacturer, but we never promise that a recipe will change or that a product will come back, because these decisions belong to the brand.

titre: Expired or short-dated product on arrival
texte: We guarantee that every product arrives with at least 30 days left before its best-before or use-by date, or at least half of its total shelf life for products that keep less than 60 days, such as fresh bread. If a product arrives expired, or with less time left than this guarantee, the customer gets a full refund of the item without returning it, on the basis of a photo showing the date, sent within 30 days of delivery. The customer can choose a replacement instead, which we ship with a newer date. Expired products must not be eaten. We also check the remaining stock of the same product in our warehouse and remove short-dated units.

titre: Stale or rancid products before their date
texte: Nuts, seeds, crackers, chips, cereals, flours and oils can turn stale or rancid before their best-before date if they were stored badly or if the package was not properly sealed. A rancid smell or taste, often described as like paint, cardboard or old oil, means the fats have oxidised: the product should not be eaten. We refund or replace it, as the customer prefers, without return, on the basis of a photo of the date and lot number sent within 30 days of delivery. The lot number is passed to the quality team, which checks other reports and the storage conditions in our warehouse. Several reports on the same lot lead to its withdrawal from sale.

Mould is visible as fuzzy or powdery spots, often white, green, blue or black. A product with mould must not be eaten, and cutting off the visible part is not enough for soft foods, bread, jams, cheese or nuts, because mould can spread invisibly. The customer should not smell the product closely, should close it in a bag and throw it away after taking a photo. We refund the product in full, without return, even if more than 30 days have passed since delivery, because mould is a food safety concern. The lot number and photo go to the quality team. If the customer has eaten some of the product and feels unwell, the illness procedure applies.

titre: Insects or pests in a product
texte: Finding insects, larvae, webs or droppings in a product is a serious food safety concern. The customer should not eat the product, should close it in a sealed bag away from other food, and should take a photo of the insects, the package and the lot number. Pantry moths and weevils can spread to other dry foods, so we advise checking nearby flour, rice, pasta and cereals. We refund the product in full without return, and the quality and safety team contacts the customer within 24 hours to collect details. If the same lot has other reports, we withdraw it from sale and inform the manufacturer. Customers can report insects at any time, even after 30 days.

A foreign object is anything that should not be in the food: plastic, metal, glass, wood, stone, hair, or pieces of packaging. The customer should stop eating the product, keep the object and the package, and not throw them away, because the quality and safety team may need them for analysis; we send a prepaid envelope if needed. We refund the product in full immediately. The quality and safety team contacts the customer within 24 hours, takes charge of the case, and informs the manufacturer. If the customer was injured, for example a broken tooth or a cut, the injury procedure for illness and harm applies, and the case is handled personally by the safety team.

titre: Illness, injury or allergic reaction after eating
texte: When a customer reports feeling sick, an injury or an allergic reaction after eating one of our products, the first concern is their health: the reply urges them to seek medical help if symptoms are severe or continue, and to call emergency services in case of difficulty breathing. The case goes immediately to the quality and safety team, which contacts the customer within 24 hours. The reply does not discuss symptoms, causes or responsibility in public, does not suggest that the product is safe or unsafe, and asks the customer to keep the remaining product and its package. We refund the product in full. This procedure applies at any time after delivery.

If a customer finds that a product contains an allergen that is not declared on its label or on the listing, such as peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, wheat, soy, sesame, fish or shellfish, the case is a food safety emergency. The reply asks the customer not to eat the product and to keep it with its package and lot number, and the quality and safety team contacts the customer within 24 hours. We immediately suspend sales of the lot concerned while we check with the manufacturer, and we may start a recall. The product is refunded in full. If the customer had a reaction, the illness procedure applies at the same time. An allergen that is declared but was overlooked is not a defect.

When a manufacturer or a food safety authority recalls a product, we stop selling it the same day and email every customer who bought an affected lot in the last 12 months, with the instructions given by the authority. Customers do not need to make a claim: recalled products are refunded automatically to the original payment method within 5 business days, without return; the email explains how to dispose of the product safely. Current recalls are listed on the Help page. If a customer mentions in a review a recall they heard about, our reply confirms whether the product they bought is affected and points to the Help page, without guessing about other lots.

titre: Swollen cans, bulging lids or broken seals
texte: A can or jar with a swollen body, a bulging lid, a lid that does not click when opened, a hissing sound, spurting liquid, or a broken safety seal must not be opened or eaten. These signs can indicate dangerous bacterial growth or tampering. The customer should keep the product closed, take a photo, and put it in a sealed bag away from other food. We refund the product in full without return, and the quality and safety team contacts the customer within 24 hours to decide whether the product should be collected for analysis. If the product has already been eaten and the customer feels unwell, the illness procedure applies. Such reports can be made at any time.

If a customer receives a different product from the one ordered, for example another flavour, another brand or another size, we send the correct product free of charge within 2 business days, or refund it if the customer prefers or if it is out of stock. We need the order number and a photo of the product received, sent within 30 days of delivery. The customer can keep, give away or donate the wrong product; we do not ask for its return. If the wrong product contains an allergen the customer must avoid, they should not eat it, and they can tell us so in the claim. Repeated picking errors on the same product are reported to the warehouse team, which checks the shelf labels.

titre: Quantity, size or weight different from the listing
texte: Each listing states the net weight or volume and the number of units. If the product received is smaller, lighter or contains fewer units than the listing states, for example a 12-ounce bag instead of 16 ounces, or 6 cans instead of a pack of 12, the product does not match its description. The customer can choose a refund of the difference, a full refund of the item, or a replacement with the correct size. A photo of the label showing the weight or count is needed, within 30 days of delivery. We correct the listing within 7 days. Ounces and fluid ounces are different units: we check which unit the listing used before treating the report.

A listing must describe the product as it is sold today: name, photo, flavour, ingredients, size, origin and claims. If a customer receives a product that does not match the photo or description in a way that matters, such as a different flavour, a different packaging format, or a product shown as whole but sold as pieces, they can get a full refund without return, within 30 days of delivery. We correct the listing within 7 days and thank the customer for the report. Small differences in packaging design, such as a new box with the same product inside, are not a mismatch. Serving suggestions shown in photos are illustrations, and are not included in the product.

If the ingredient list on the package differs from the one shown on the listing, for example an added sweetener, a different oil or a preservative that is not mentioned, the customer can get a full refund without return, within 30 days of delivery, with a photo of the ingredient list. We ask the manufacturer for its current recipe and update the listing within 7 days. When the difference concerns one of the major allergens, such as peanuts, milk, eggs, wheat, soy, sesame, tree nuts, fish or shellfish, the case is handled as an undeclared allergen under the food safety procedure, which is faster. Customers with allergies should always rely on the label of the product they hold.

Some listings carry dietary claims: gluten-free, vegan, organic, kosher, keto, sugar-free, non-GMO. If the product received does not carry the claim shown on the listing, or its label contradicts the claim, the customer can get a full refund without return, within 30 days of delivery, with a photo of the label. We remove the claim from the listing the same day and ask the manufacturer for its certificates. We do not test products ourselves and we rely on the manufacturer's certification. If a customer with coeliac disease or another medical condition reports symptoms after eating a product sold as gluten-free or free of an ingredient, the illness procedure also applies.

We buy every product directly from the brand or from distributors authorised by the brand, and we do not sell products from other sellers. If a customer believes a product is counterfeit, for example because the packaging, the language of the label, the batch code format or the taste differs from the product they know, we ask for photos of the package and the lot number, and we check them with the brand. While the check is in progress, the customer gets a full refund without return. Imported versions of a product, labelled for another country, can be sold legitimately, but the listing must say so; if it did not, the policy on misleading descriptions applies.

We never replace an ordered product with another one without the customer's consent. When a product is out of stock after the order is placed, we email the customer and either cancel the item with a full refund, or propose a similar product that the customer must accept. If a customer nevertheless receives a substitute they did not accept, they can keep it and get a full refund of the ordered item, within 30 days of delivery; no return is needed. Customers can turn off substitution proposals completely in the settings of their account. A different packaging of the same product, with identical contents and size, is not a substitution.

We set our own prices and we do not match the prices of other online stores, supermarkets, warehouse clubs or the manufacturer's website, and we do not refund the difference when a customer finds the same product cheaper elsewhere. Our prices include the careful packaging of fragile and perishable products, which some cheaper offers do not. Every listing shows the unit price, per ounce or per count, so that customers can compare formats and stores before ordering. A reply to a price comparison thanks the customer, explains that we do not match prices, and may point to the current promotions page, without offering an individual discount.

Prices change when our suppliers change theirs, and during promotions. We do not refund past orders when a price changes later, with one exception: if the price of an item drops within 7 days after the customer's order, the customer can ask for the difference to be refunded, once per item and per order, through the Help page. This price protection does not apply to flash sales lasting less than 24 hours, to bundles, or to prices from other stores. When a customer complains that a price has gone up compared with a previous order, the reply can explain that our prices follow supplier costs, and that the unit price is shown on every listing.

If a promotion, coupon or discount code was valid when the customer placed the order but was not applied, we refund the missing discount to the original payment method, on request within 30 days of delivery. The customer should give the order number and the name of the promotion or code. Promotions have conditions shown on the promotions page, such as a minimum order amount, eligible products or one use per customer; when these conditions were not met, the discount is not owed, and the reply explains which condition applied. Codes cannot be combined unless the promotion says so, and expired codes are not honoured.

titre: Value for money and package size
texte: Some customers feel that a product is too expensive for its size, or that the package is mostly air. Package sizes and filling are decided by the manufacturer; snack bags contain air to protect the product from crushing, and contents can settle during transport. Every listing states the net weight and the unit price, which are the best way to judge value before buying. A complaint about value for money does not lead to a refund when the product matches its listing, but we forward it to the brand in our monthly summary. If the net weight received is lower than the listing states, the policy on quantity, size and weight applies instead.

Customers can subscribe to regular deliveries of a product every 2, 4, 6 or 8 weeks, with a 5 percent discount on each delivery. The price charged is the price on the day the delivery ships, not the price on the day of subscription, because prices can change; we email the customer 3 days before each shipment with the current price, and the customer can skip, change or cancel the delivery until then, at no cost. If a customer was charged for a subscription delivery after cancelling it before the deadline, we refund it in full and the customer can keep the products. Subscriptions can be managed in the account.

Shipping is free for orders of $35 or more after discounts. Below $35, standard shipping costs $5.99, and express shipping costs $12.99 regardless of the order amount. Heat-sensitive and refrigerated products do not add extra fees, because the cost of insulated packaging is included in their price. Shipping fees are shown before payment and are not refunded when a customer changes their mind, but they are refunded when the whole order is lost, when the delivery is more than 3 business days late, or when the whole order is affected by a problem covered by this policy. A complaint about shipping fees alone does not lead to a refund.

titre: Multipacks priced higher than single units
texte: Customers occasionally notice that a multipack costs more per unit than the same product sold individually, which is the opposite of what they expect. This can happen when supplier prices for the two formats change at different times. We check every such report within 7 days and correct the price if it is an error. If the customer bought the multipack during the period when it cost more per unit than the single units, we refund the difference between the two unit prices for the units bought, on request through the Help page, within 30 days of delivery. The reply thanks the customer for spotting the error.
